title: Adaptive Computation with Conformal Certification
abstract: arXiv:2610.19189v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific imaging data involving medical (e.g., 3D radiographic, microscopic images) and astronomical sensors pose different challenges from natural images. One key challenge is that these datasets are often orders of magnitude larger than natural images. Efficient training and inference on such data is challenging due to the increased hardware requirements, often needing bespoke solutions. Moreover, the relevant objects such as tumors and astronomical phenomena are sparsely distributed with respect to the background information. Standard efficiency techniques like quantization and pruning apply uniform scaling of all regions, potentially compromising the precision/fidelity of predictions. Thus, efficient methods that reduce computational requirements without losing resolution for relevant parts of the data and with uncertainty estimates on predictions are essential. We present \textit{Conformal Adaptation} with risk guarantees for unce

translated_title: 基于保形认证的自适应计算
translated_abstract: 涉及医学（如3D放射影像、显微图像）和天文传感器的科学成像数据带来了与自然图像不同的挑战。一个关键挑战是这些数据集的规模通常比自然图像大几个数量级。由于硬件需求增加，在这些数据上进行高效的训练和推理十分困难，往往需要定制的解决方案。此外，肿瘤和天文现象等相关目标相对于背景信息呈稀疏分布。量化、剪枝等标准效率提升技术会对所有区域进行统一缩放，可能损害预测的精度/保真度。因此，能够在不损失数据相关部分分辨率的前提下降低计算需求、并为预测提供不确定性估计的高效方法至关重要。我们提出了具有风险保证的“保形自适应”方法……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文提出“保形自适应”方法，利用保形认证为科学成像数据（医学与天文图像）的自适应计算提供统计风险保证，在降低计算成本的同时保留关键稀疏区域的分辨率并提供可靠的不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Conformal Adaptation, which leverages conformal certification to provide statistical risk guarantees for adaptive computation on large-scale scientific imaging data, reducing computational cost while preserving resolution for sparse regions of interest with reliable uncertainty quantification.
